title: Through-composed music
description: Relatively continuous, non-sectional, or non-repetitive music
extract: In the theory of musical form, through-composed music is a continuous, non-sectional, and non-repetitive piece of music. The term is typically used to describe songs, but can also apply to instrumental music.
